title: Affine ideal tensor sections comparison
statement: Let i : Z → X be a closed immersion, U an affine open of X, R a commutative ring, r : R ≃+* Γ(X,U) a ring isomorphism and I = ker(i.app U ∘ r). There exists an r-semilinear equivalence from I tensor_R (R/I) to Γ((pushforward i).obj ((tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules),U), sending a tensor 1 to the adjunction-unit image of every ideal-module section s with inclusion r(a). The objects and adjunction are those of [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

source.place: Lemma 01R3 (2), affine tensor comparison before the identification I tensor_R R/I = I/I²; Schemes, Lemma 01I9 (1)-(2).

proof.text: The ideal module is the kernel of the structure-module map to the closed-subscheme pushforward. Structure modules, closed-immersion pushforwards and kernels are quasi-coherent.

Put A = Γ(X,U), V = i⁻¹U, and ρ = i.app U. The closed immersion is affine and ρ is surjective. The section inclusion of the ideal module is injective and has range ker ρ. Transport along r identifies these sections with I, and the first isomorphism theorem identifies Γ(Z,V) with R/I.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to the ideal module and the affine opens U,V. Transport the comparison along the section identifications from the previous step to obtain the r-semilinear equivalence I tensor_R R/I to pullback sections on V. The pure-tensor formula at b=1 identifies a tensor 1 with the adjunction-unit section. Pushforward on U restricts scalars along ρ, giving the displayed target. This step does not identify the tensor product with the cotangent quotient.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 01R3 (2), with the affine pullback description of Schemes 01I9.

theorem affine_ideal_tensor_sections {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] :
      ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
        (r : R ≃+* Γ(X, U.1)) (I : Ideal R),
        I = RingHom.ker ((i.app U.1).hom.comp (r : R →+* Γ(X, U.1))) →
        ∃ e : LinearEquiv (r : R →+* Γ(X, U.1))
            (σ' := (r.symm : Γ(X, U.1) →+* R)) (I ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I))
            Γ((pushforward i).obj ((tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules), U.1),
          ∀ (a : I) (s : Γ(i.ker.toModules, U.1)),
            i.ker.toModulesι.app U.1 s = r (a : R) →
            e (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R ⧸ I)) =
              ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
                i.ker.toModules).app U.1 s
